description: This file implements a set of functions for managing a hierarchical repository structure, including adding, deleting, retrieving, and configuring folders and records. It is part of the Sys Repository Driver Object for a BroadWay Runtime System Environment.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE SysRdoAddFolder1(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * pFolderName,ULONG ulPermission,ULONG ulFolderType,ANSC_HANDLE hRenderAttr,ANSC_HANDLE hReserved)
methods.description: Adds a folder object at the root or under the root folder, depending on implementation, with specified attributes.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE SysRdoAddFolder2(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hCurFolder,char * pSubFolderName,ULONG ulPermission,ULONG ulFolderType,ANSC_HANDLE hRenderAttr,ANSC_HANDLE hReserved)
methods.description: Creates a subfolder within a specified current folder, parsing a folder path string and creating intermediate folders as needed.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SysRdoDelFolder1(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * pFolderName,BOOL bRecursive,BOOL bForceful)
methods.description: Deletes a folder identified by name from the root, optionally recursively and forcefully.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SysRdoDelFolder2(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hCurFolder,char * pSubFolderName,BOOL bRecursive,BOOL bForceful)
methods.description: Deletes a specified subfolder under a current folder, optionally recursively and forcefully.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE SysRdoGetFolder1(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * pFolderName)
methods.description: Retrieves a folder by name starting from the root folder.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE SysRdoGetFolder2(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hCurFolder,char * pSubFolderName)
methods.description: Retrieves a subfolder within a specified current folder, parsing a path string.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE SysRdoAddRecord(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * pRecordName,ULONG ulPermission,ULONG ulRecordType,ANSC_HANDLE hRenderAttr,PVOID pBuffer,ULONG ulSize)
methods.description: Adds a record to a folder specified by a hierarchical path, with associated data.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SysRdoDelRecord(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * pRecordName)
methods.description: Deletes a record identified by name within the folder hierarchy.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE SysRdoGetRecord(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * pRecordName)
methods.description: Retrieves a record object by hierarchical name.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SysRdoSetRecord(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * pRecordName,ULONG ulRecordType,ANSC_HANDLE hRenderAttr,PVOID pBuffer,ULONG ulSize)
methods.description: Configures or modifies a record's data and attributes by name within the folder hierarchy.
